scientific_summary: Current latent zₜ, action aₜ and recurrent state hₜ condition an LSTM update. Updated hₜ₊₁ supports an MDN Gaussian-mixture distribution for zₜ₊₁ and also passes through separately. Temperature τ controls distribution sampling; sampled next latent and updated state are distinct outputs.
invariants: World Models M component, Ha and Schmidhuber 2018; not a latest model or full V-M-C architecture.
LSTM updated state supports the MDN head and is also retained as the separate recurrent-state output.
The mixture head outputs π/μ/σ of the stochastic next-latent distribution; it is not a deterministic future prediction.
Only the predictive distribution enters the temperature-controlled sampler; hidden state never passes through sampling.
The dynamics-to-prediction boundary carries a distribution/state tuple, not a new arithmetic merge.
No sampled-future-latent arrow to Controller C, no done/reward head, and no invented Transformer/diffusion block.
Mixture curves and vector marks are schematic model representations without measured values.
layout: Content-sized left input frame and detailed middle/right scientific regions share bottom y=650. Current context enters dynamics on a straight horizontal arrow at y=510. Dynamics sends the grouped distribution/state tuple to prediction on another straight horizontal arrow at y=420. No exterior feedback or staircase. True internal recurrence/density/sampling topology is explicitly drawn inside its parent regions.
typography: Arial; black scientific headings and labels, real Greek letters and true subscripts. Keep formulas readable and all text within regions. No gray microcopy or automatic colored title strip.

local_visuals.meaning: One real recurrent update with its density head
local_visuals.construction: Within dynamics [490,180,900,470], place LSTM around [600,450,240,120] and the MDN/Gaussian-mixture head above around [600,240,240,110]. The grouped context enters the LSTM via a short straight extension from the external input landing y=510. Updated hₜ₊₁ leaves LSTM right at y=510 as a straight lower state channel; it also branches upward from the top of LSTM to the MDN bottom on a single vertical source-supported state connector. Label that state branch hₜ₊₁ once. MDN outputs π/μ/σ to the right into a compact mixture-parameter representation, around [930,240,330,150]. Use small smooth Gaussian curves as an abstract distribution glyph, not a measured graph. Below it typeset P(zₜ₊₁ | aₜ, zₜ, hₜ). At the right edge collect the upper distribution channel and lower state channel with a thin tuple brace spanning y=280..550; it is not a processing node. The exterior output leaves the overall region at y=420. Put the recurrence equation low inside the region at y≈610. Local scientific branching is justified by the actual model, while the outer frame still has exactly one input and one output.

A short rightward arrow leaves Sample and lands on zₜ₊₁, with Sampled latent below, near x=2030/y=325. The separate lower channel runs at y≈520 straight to a recurrent-state vector mark hₜ₊₁ near x=2010, with Updated state. No connector from that lower channel may touch the sampler or sampled z. detail_hierarchy.common_depth: Current context and terminal outputs are typed latent/action/state objects; the actual novel mechanism is shown at LSTM, MDN mixture and sampling depth.
detail_hierarchy.peer_depth_observation: The author SVG exposes repeated recurrent cells, their MDN heads, state links, latent/action conditions and temperature rather than using a model-name card.

innovation_focuses.claim: Recurrent stochastic latent dynamics predict a Gaussian mixture rather than one deterministic future.
innovation_focuses.draw_to: LSTM updated state, MDN weights/means/scales, conditional next-latent law, temperature sampling and independent state output.
